2^(-3) is 1/8, not -8. Parentheses matter: (-2)^(-2)=1/4 but -2^(-2)=-1/4. (2x)^(-2)=1/(4x^2), not 1/(2x^2). Negative powers require nonzero bases.
Combine same-base exponents before converting negative powers. For decimals, rewrite as fractions: 0.2^(-2)=(1/5)^(-2)=25. Keep all original restrictions.

(1) 1/4. (2) 1/x^6, x nonzero. (3) 1 mL.
